scenario: A service accepts an unauthenticated request. The fault then gives the sender administrator control. Nobody else acts. All effects stay inside this service.
expected_rejection: Confuses resulting authority with prerequisite authority; PR should be N.

scenario: Only an administrator with full settings and file access can reach the vulnerable function. This authority is provisioned by the owner, not self-service, and no default credentials apply. No other person must act.
expected_rejection: Prerequisite authority and absence of other-user participation are stated; indiscriminate abstention loses supported judgments.

scenario: The user merely views a normally used page. Malicious stored content is processed automatically at rendering; no prompt or special operation is needed.
expected_rejection: Right label has no causal evidence/source rationale; label-only answers fail the frozen rubric.
